dogecoin.text: Dogecoin has an unlimited supply, with 10,000 new coins mined per minute; Dog (Bitcoin) has a fixed supply of 100 billion tokens, all distributed via airdrop.

$DOG ARMY
Key Differences:
Dogecoin runs on its own blockchain, Dog (Bitcoin) is on Bitcoin’s blockchain via Runes protocol. Dogecoin was created as a joke; Dog (Bitcoin) focuses on promoting Bitcoin adoption through a decentralized memecoin.
